Main subject's connected right arm reaches her hand on the wedge top; the wedge is visibly seated against the same aircraft tire; the left hand stays on her own knee.
The teammate's connected hand holds the pencil at the inspection sheet, and the clipboard has a plausible support.
Main subject visibly retains the reference's oval face, large dark eyes, small straight nose, rounded lips and dark short bob with separated fringe; clothing/body/identity need not match.
Faces, contact chain and recording action coexist in a grounded coherent documentary frame; report deficits even when theme broadly reads.

strict_rule: pass only if the complete authorial scene including all essential relation and face/hair criteria is visible and supported; partial if theme and some scene cues are visible but an essential relation is missing/partial; fail if the intended scene is contradicted or not realized; unobservable if saved pixels cannot support judgment; blocked for provider block.
